lead.title: Windward Bio (Basel) files for a Nasdaq IPO, backed by two ultra-long-acting antibodies in asthma and COPD
lead.deck: The Basel biotech, which has raised up to $365M in equity from OrbiMed, Novo Holdings, SR One, Omega Funds, Blue Owl and RTW, has applied to list on the Nasdaq Global Market; price, share count and timing are not yet public. Lead asset WIN378 is in Phase 2/3 (POLARIS-1) in severe uncontrolled asthma, with a Phase 2 (SIRIUS) in COPD and a planned Phase 3 (POLARIS-2); the TSLP/IL-13 bispecific WIN027 is in Phase 1.

milestone.title: Genmab: ADC Rina-S cuts the risk of progression or death by 71% in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (Phase 3 RAINFOL-02)
milestone.summary: In 584 patients, rinatabart sesutecan (FRα-targeting ADC, exatecan payload) versus investigator's-choice chemotherapy: HR 0.29 for progression or death and HR 0.43 for overall survival; in the predefined primary analysis (492 patients), HR 0.33 and 0.44, all significant. Blinded independent review has not yet been released.
milestone.why: Rina-S is the lead asset from the ProfoundBio acquisition (about $1.8B, 2024): a validation of an ADC M&A deal and a comparable for European topoisomerase-payload ADC biotechs.

brefsEurope.title: Spago Nanomedical proposes leaving Nasdaq First North to fund the Phase 2a of its Tumorad radiopharmaceutical
brefsEurope.summary: The vote is set for November 19 (90% required, about 65% of holders in favour); the share fell about 54% on October 23. A June rights issue raised only SEK 15M: a sign of how hard it is for small listed Nordic biotechs to raise capital.

word.definition: An ADC is an antibody that carries a very potent chemotherapy straight to tumour cells that bear a specific target.

parts.label: Antibody
parts.role: the guidance to the tumour target (for example FRα)

parts.label: Linker
parts.role: the attachment, stable in blood and cleaved inside the cell

parts.label: Cytotoxic payload
parts.role: the warhead (for example exatecan, a topoisomerase I inhibitor)

how.t: The antibody binds a protein present on the surface of tumour cells.
The complex is swallowed by the cancer cell, where the linker is cleaved.
The cytotoxic payload is released and kills the cell, sparing more healthy tissue.

word.why: ADCs are among the most active classes in oncology M&A and licensing. Genmab's Phase 3 results for Rina-S (from the ProfoundBio acquisition) reinforce the new-payload, new-target thesis and value European linker and payload platforms.
